text: Done at 8201293: distance correlation has a typed work bound (DistanceCorrelationLimit, default 2^28 unordered pairs, ~0.45 s at the limit on M3 Max) with CompareError.WorkLimitExceeded and a catalogued diagnostic; 2.8x faster (256^2: 11.0 s -> 3.6 s); agrees with the old implementation to 2.8e-12.
